build.// dependsOn: ^generate (#260): a cold build must produce the untracked Prisma client itself (the bundle imports it as a runtime value; i18n types are import-type and erased). Declare PER-PROJECT — a `build` key in nx.json targetDefaults creates a phantom build target on every source-only lib and fails them under @nx/enforce-module-boundaries. `^build` is repeated because a project-level dependsOn replaces a default rather than merging. Full reasoning: issue #260. `buf-export` writes the protos the bundle serves from, which webpack copies from libs/proto/gateway/proto-export: that directory is gitignored, nothing else in this graph writes it, and the copy skips a missing one without a word, leaving a bundle that exits as it boots.
